source: NFL.com Friday roundup Oct 9 + Yahoo injury tracker; official Friday designations; ETR Week 5 previews (Sat): Bigsby to IR, Pierce promoted from PS; OL outs + play-caller notes from ETR previews Oct 10

team_notes.PHI: Line upheaval beyond the report: Lane Johnson retired midweek and Cam Jurgens was traded. The offense fell to 28th in EPA/play without Johnson last year.
team_notes.HOU: DeMeco Ryans takes over defensive play-calling from Matt Burke this week.
team_notes.DEN: Sean Payton takes back offensive play-calling from Davis Webb.
team_notes.MIA: Claimed Kaytron Allen off waivers Friday; dead last in plays from scrimmage.
team_notes.ARI: Offensive line unraveling: Paris Johnson out for the year, Isaiah Adams out, his backup tore an ACL.
